text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Macedonian soldier Tihomir Antonovski was killed while cleaning automatic rifles in the watch tower Konjare close to Debar at the Macedonian-Albanian border crossing.
- Mobile telephone network with its 3,000 subsrcibers is spreading in Macedonia.
- Opposition IMRO-DPMNY organised anti-government demonstrations throughout Macedonia on Saturday demanding resignation of the government and early elections.
